halo.title: An SOS you can start with your phone in your bag.
halo.lede: HalO is a discreet safety ring and companion app concept for women commuting alone in urban and rural India. The ring triggers the emergency. The app handles everything before and after it.

reframe.title: Make the page easier to read. Keep the reader in charge.
reframe.lede: Reframe is a reading layer that makes dense government pages easier to read, without letting AI change the rules on them.

steer.title: Taking a driving school off the group chat.
steer.lede: Steer gives supervisors one live view of the school and gives instructors a clear view of the next lesson. Both work from the same record, so a change made at the desk reaches the car, and a lesson logged in the car gets back to the desk.

atlas.title: Delegate the work. Keep the judgment.
atlas.lede: A control center that lets people hand multi-step work to AI agents, approve exactly what goes out, and recover the work when a run breaks.

lineage.title: Creative Lineage Canvas - Recover the shadow. Keep the progress.
lineage.lede: Creative Lineage Canvas helps a designer bring back an earlier approved element while keeping the rest of the poster as it is today.
